title: Environment declares no interpreter version
description: Pipfile declares a Pipfile that declares no interpreter version. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a Pipfile that declares no interpreter version.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a Pipfile that declares no interpreter version.
limitation: It matches a Pipfile that declares no interpreter version in the parsed Pipfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
